purpose: Fixed before implementing obligation-planner arms. Source-backed required IDs test coverage, not final answer accuracy. Cases F1-F6 and Q2c were previously exposed; N1-N4 are new transfer checks.

cases.question: In Formly v6, how should I conditionally hide or disable a field, and what happens to the model value and control when a field is hidden?
My model has amount: 0, and the field has defaultValue: 10. Will building the field change it? If I call updateInitialValue() after an edit, what will a later resetModel() restore?
If I hide a field but need to keep its answer, does resetOnHide: false also keep its control registered?
Can I safely change an expression target from templateOptions.disabled to props.disabled when a parent field may be disabled?
I registered a plain core FieldType in a Material form. Does that supply the mat-form-field shell and Material control integration automatically?
Why can key: 'secret' and type: 'passwordBox' legitimately differ in one field config?
Which HTTP and RxJS pattern should I use to fetch an initial value after the fields have built, and exactly when should Formly write it?
After changing a flag, does options.checkExpressions(field) also mark components for change detection, or should I call options.detectChanges(field)?
In an onInit hook I return one Observable but manually subscribe to another. Which subscription does Formly dispose?
If a hidden FormArray has child values and a defaultValue, what can happen to the children on hide and to the default when it is shown again?
Can Formly automatically store completed forms in PostgreSQL without my application writing persistence code?
